mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals a weakening labor market that may precipitate a recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (indicating reduced manufacturing output) and housing starts (indicating weak consumer demand for homes) signal a broad economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 210), a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 210 and FEDFUNDS rises above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 1000 units signals a contraction in the residential construction sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signal a severe labor market deterioration that may lead to a recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low industrial production (INDPRO < 110), a rebound in industrial output above 112 signals a recovery in manufacturing activity that boosts corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110 and INDPRO rebounds above 112.
